body:
Added PC_SPRINT_SPEED (59.375 units/sec) converted directly from SHANKPIT's real MAX_SPEED=0.95/tick at its 62.5Hz fixed tick (SHANKPIT_NET_FIXED_DT=0.016s, confirmed via update_entity's direct per-tick p->x += p->vx with no dt multiply) -- not guessed. PC_MOVE_SPEED (4.0, walking) stays default; new PC_BTN_SPRINT protocol bit, server-enforced mutual exclusion with crouch, stacks under the existing move-stat/slide-jump multipliers. Client: Left Shift moved from crouch (now Ctrl-only) to sole sprint key per founder confirmation (AskUserQuestion), controller L3 mirrors it. Both day server and client build clean; papercraft_falling_test re-verified clean. Commit 6ad5ed7.

⚓ ☃
title: S504-10c: SHANKPIT/PAPERCRAFT physics unification — walk/sprint speed split, Shift=run
